items.line: [[Lewes]] – this gorgeous medieval town has a castle, as well as '''Glyndebourne Opera House''', a famous opera house, set in beautiful grounds where opera-goers eat gourmet picnics at intervals which can be brought in or ordered from their own catering service. {{mi|11}} from Brighton and 20 minutes away by train.

[[Dieppe]], France – by ferry from [[Newhaven]] Harbour, about {{mi|9}} east of Brighton. Services are three daily and take around four hours. The service is operated by [https://www.dfds.com/en-gb/passenger-ferries/ferry-crossings/ferries-to-france/newhaven-dieppe DFDS]
[[Rottingdean]] – in the east of Brighton, with memories of Kipling, Burne-Jones and several other artists.
[[London]] – an hour away via train or 2 hours via coach.
[[Worthing]] – There is no reason you wouldn't want to visit this lovely town. Short journey via train from Brighton Station.
